title: Turn regrets into a character’s arc
description: You keep replaying a painful fallout with a former business partner. Instead of writing a diary entry, you write a short story about an aging clockmaker who refuses to fix his mentor’s broken pocket watch—and what he discovers when he finally opens it.

title: Turn bureaucracy into human stories
description: Tax reforms, zoning laws, or privacy policies feel impenetrable. You write about an architect trying to explain to his stubborn grandfather why the backyard tool shed he built thirty years ago is suddenly illegal.

title: Test-drive tomorrow’s headlines today
description: A new digital currency law is proposed. Instead of analyzing clause 4b, you write about a corner store owner trying to buy a loaf of bread on the first morning the law goes live.

title: Lower the temperature on heated debates
description: You want to discuss the ethics of automated traffic surveillance without starting a flame war. You write a tale about a small-town delivery driver whose GPS starts arguing back about the morality of shortcuts.
